items.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.en_title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.en_oneliner: Hugging Face launched a public dashboard to compare llama.cpp prompt processing and generation speed across hardware, models, and quantization settings on AMD Ryzen and Radeon, and to track performance changes across builds.

items.title: v4.1.28
items.en_oneliner: Cline ships v4.1.28, refreshing its model list so the OpenAI provider drops IDs the upstream catalog has marked deprecated.

items.title: desktop-v0.0.51
items.en_oneliner: Cline's desktop app ships maintenance release v0.0.51.

items.title: CLI v3.0.76
items.en_oneliner: Cline CLI v3.0.76 bundles a single third-party notice at the npm package root covering every platform binary, refreshes the built-in model catalog, and drops upstream-removed models from the OpenAI picker.

items.title: SDK v0.2.2
items.en_oneliner: Cline SDK v0.2.2 cleans up internal telemetry, trimming related exports and dependencies.

items.title: SDK TypeScript Release v0.1.36
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code's TypeScript SDK reaches v0.1.36, bundling CLI 0.28.6 so developers can call on Qwen Code's capabilities directly from their projects.

items.title: Release v0.28.6
items.en_oneliner: Managed sessions can now pause while waiting on tool approvals, questions, or Hooks and MCP decisions, and pick up again after a Harness restart through cold recovery.

items.title: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: Open Data, Fine-Tuning, and Faster Inference
items.en_title: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: Open Data, Fine-Tuning, and Faster Inference
items.en_oneliner: A hands-on guide to NVIDIA's document-parsing model Nemotron 3.5 Parse, covering open training data, fine-tuning, and faster inference to help developers wire document parsing into their own workflows.

items.title: Benchmarking coding agents on the work developers bring to Kiro
items.en_title: Benchmarking coding agents on the work developers bring to Kiro
items.en_oneliner: Kiro has unveiled its internal benchmark KiroBench: more than 300 tasks drawn from real development work by Amazon engineers, spanning feature work, bug fixing, refactoring and other multi-turn scenarios, scored in runnable environments with verifiers to sidestep the leakage and narrow coverage of public benchmarks.

items.title: v2.4.2
items.en_oneliner: Open source AI coding agent OpenCode ships maintenance release v2.4.2, with no detailed changelog published this time.

items.title: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization
items.en_title: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization
items.en_oneliner: If you haven't picked a billing method for Copilot code review for licensed members, the cost will automatically be charged to your organization from December 30, 2026.

items.title: Building a software factory around human attention
items.en_title: Building a software factory around human attention
items.en_oneliner: The Kiro team shares a year of practice: agents run the full development cycle from discovery to release and monitoring on their own, with people stepping in only where a real decision is needed.

items.title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
items.en_title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
items.en_oneliner: Scientists discuss how far AI agents should go in research and which lines must not be crossed, drawing a reference boundary for agent autonomy.

items.title: v2.75.0 (2026-11-25)
items.en_oneliner: This release tightens instruction authority for workspace files, keeping RepoContext, Skills and Memory content below operator level, and adds a lowest_authority_under setting.
